name: Prison bars section
description: A 1.5 m section of a prison cell's front, 2.4 m high: ten round iron bars from a dressed grey stone sill up into a heavy stone lintel, held by flat iron rails and a riveted cross band, a few bars rusted. Sections join side by side, and with the matching barred door.

provenance.prompt: A 1.5 m section of floor-to-lintel iron bars in a stone sill, about 2.4 m high, joins side by side.
